def format_currency_no_cents(amount):
    rounded = round(amount)
    sign = '-' if rounded < 0 else ''
    digits = str(abs(rounded))
    groups = []
    while len(digits) > 3:
        groups.insert(0, digits[-3:])
        digits = digits[:-3]
    groups.insert(0, digits)
    return f"{sign}${','.join(groups)}"

def top_k_frequent(nums, k):
    distinct = set(nums)
    freq_pairs = [(-nums.count(v), v) for v in distinct]
    freq_pairs.sort()
    return [v for _, v in freq_pairs[:k]]
